rationale: This is an awesome-list (curated link collection) documenting browser automation tools and resources, not a source-code project. It contains zero implementation code, no tests, and no architecture documents. The README.md lists ~50 browser automation tools across categories (Tools, AI, Related tools, Articles, Resources) with links to external projects. Relevance to the scraping pipeline is limited to awareness of available tools; it provides no reusable components, libraries, or architectural patterns. Tier D reflects that this is only a focused scan of a documentation repository with no implementation depth.
limitations: No source code to analyze for implementation capabilities
No tests, benchmarks, or performance data
Curated links may become stale (lint workflow checks links but external projects evolve independently)
Cannot assess code quality, maintenance health, or licensing of listed tools
